{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for missing values
missing_values = df.isnull().sum()

# Check for sentinel values (e.g., -999.0 for missing)
sentinel_count = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0).sum()

# Check the distribution of sex
df['sex'].value_counts()

# Check the distribution of the arm (treatment vs control)
df['arm'].value_counts()

# Check if the trial was randomized (by checking balance across arms by sex)
randomization_check = pd.crosstab(df['arm'], df['sex'])

missing_values, sentinel_count, df['sex'].value_counts(), df['arm'].value_counts(), randomization_check"}
